issues.description: Field 'numberOfTutors' has inconsistent types across artifacts: the UML in the problem statement declares numberOfTutors as int (problem_statement.md), while the solution implementation declares the field as short and uses short for the constructor parameter and setter. This mismatch can confuse students about the intended type and lead to inconsistent constructor/setter signatures or failing type-based tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type consistent between the specification and the implementation. Either change the solution to use int for numberOfTutors (field declaration, constructor parameter, getter/setter signatures) to match the UML, or update the UML/problem statement to declare numberOfTutors: short and ensure all example signatures and tests expect short.
